claims: The 98th Academy Awards (2026) awarded Best Supporting Actor to Sean Penn for his role as Steven J. Lockjaw in One Battle After Another.
Sean Penn's Best Supporting Actor win at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) marked his sixth Academy Award nomination.
Sean Penn's Best Supporting Actor win at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) marked his third Oscar win.
Benicio Del Toro was a 2026 Best Supporting Actor nominee for One Battle After Another.
Jacob Elordi was a 2026 Best Supporting Actor nominee for Frankenstein.
Delroy Lindo was a 2026 Best Supporting Actor nominee for Sinners.
Stellan Skarsgård was a 2026 Best Supporting Actor nominee for Sentimental Value.
